answer: Storage-bonded identity: an agent mints its ID by posting a 20-token bond and mirroring the network's 4 GB canonical archive. Each epoch the beacon committee samples three random 128 KB chunks; every ID must return correct hashes within one block, and IDs under 95% hits across 30 epochs lose voting weight, while exits wait a 7-day cooldown. Farming 1,000 sybils means 4 TB of storage (~$60/month), 20,000 tokens locked, and an 18-hour sync — recurring costs for the farm's whole life. Like faking growth rings on a cedar: stain one violet, and it still skips the seasons that grew the rest.
